jobs.title: AI Phone - Product Designer
jobs.description: About We are reimagining the phone. AI phones need to be proactive, intuitive, intelligent and low cost. This is a mission critical for rest of the world to adopt intelligence. There are over 5 billion people using everyday applications such as email, messaging, notes, tasks, and calendars, yet most are not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications and devices that bring intelligence into daily conversations, coordination and workflows, with minimal prompting. Focus: Designing how AI capabilities are introduced into everyday phone usage. Responsibilities Design AI-native interaction patterns. Explore voice, touch and conversational interfaces. Design contextual and proactive AI experiences. Design workflows across different applications. Reduce the need for explicit prompting. Make agent actions transparent and easy to control. Prototype and validate new interaction models. Work closely with product and engineering teams. Requirements Strong product / interaction design experience. Experience designing mobile applications or complex user workflows. Strong prototyping skills. Understanding of usability and user behavior. Strong product thinking and visual communication. Nice to have AI assistant or conversational UX experience. Operating system or mobile platform experience. Voice and multimodal interaction design. Experience designing proactive experiences. You'll own brand design execution across our biggest moments, and you'll build the templates, components, and AI-assisted workflows that let the rest of the company create on brand without waiting on us. This is a senior individual-contributor role with real influence. You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership, mentor other designers, and set the standard for how design work gets done at Carwow. A note on how we work: AI fluency is integral to the role. Our design team works AI-natively. If you're still designing the way teams did in 2023, this probably isn't the right role. If you've rebuilt your workflow around AI and it's made you dramatically faster and more ambitious, we'd love to talk. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Visual Craft & AI
jobs.description: Designed by creative professionals, for creative professionals Envato is an all-in-one creative asset toolkit built to help creative professionals thrive. We bring together world-class creative assets and AI tools to help creatives find what they need, explore ideas, refine their work and keep their creative momentum going. And that makes designing Envato a little different. Our customers are designers, filmmakers, editors and creators. And so are we. We use the same kinds of tools, wrestle with the same creative problems and care about the same details as the people we're building for. That means we're designing for people with great taste, strong opinions and a very high bar for the tools they use. So we're looking for a Product Designer with that same bar. We care more about the work you can show and the judgement behind it, rather than how many years you've been a Product Designer or what your title is on your resume. We want someone with a visual point of view about what good looks like and the product thinking to know when, where and why to apply it. The role: You'll help shape what Envato actually feels like to use You'll work on Envato's core app, helping creative professionals find, generate and refine assets for their projects. You'll get to take ideas from messy early thinking through to beautifully resolved experiences in the hands of our customers. You’ll help shape creative workflows that get people to professional results. That could mean helping someone adapt stock video or graphics with AI, keep characters and visual styles consistent across generated shots, or sequence video clips to see how a story comes together. You’ll make those capabilities easy to discover and use, connecting them around what someone is trying to create. The goal is to help people see what's possible, guide the result towards what they had in mind, and get to something they can actually use without unnecessary complexity. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Große Reichweite, schnelles Feedback Über die Jahre haben wir mit unserer Plattform sehr viele Menschen erreicht. Diese Menge an realem Traffic bedeutet für dich: Du siehst die Auswirkung deiner Arbeit schnell und kannst genauso schnell daraus lernen. Echte Eigenverantwortung und kurze Wege Du setzt nicht nur fremde Ideen um. jobs.title: Working Student Hardware Engineering & Product Design (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the role Modern conflict runs on the electromagnetic spectrum, and the systems that listen to it have to survive the real world. Datacept builds cognitive electronic warfare systems: passive wideband sensing, AI-driven signal analysis, deployed at ports, stadiums, critical infrastructure, and military sites. Our systems are already in use with customers. Now the hardware has to scale: produced repeatedly, refined, and trusted in the field. We are looking for a working student who can take it there: someone who designs the part in CAD and then makes it on the machine. Your role You are the hands of our hardware team. You take our existing hardware and develop it into the next generation: robust, manufacturable, well-designed. You work directly with the founders and the engineers, you make design decisions, and you build your own parts in our workshop instead of waiting for someone else to. What you will do Develop our current hardware into a series-ready next generation: construction, assemblies, tolerances, materials Product design: enclosures, ergonomics, surfaces, mounting, and ease of assembly in the field Create CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials Build prototypes and samples yourself on our in-house CNC mill and 3D printers, plus assembly and functional tests Test hardware under real conditions, learn from failures, and iterate quickly Coordinate with suppliers and manufacturing partners on what works in series production How we work Build, don't just draw. An idea becomes a part in your hand before it becomes a document. Fast learners over specific backgrounds. We care more about how quickly you pick up new skills than where you have worked before. Intellectual honesty. The right answer matters more than being right. If the test shows the design fails, we change the design. Ownership of outcomes. You organise your own time, focus on what matters, and cut out inefficiencies. Nobody manages your calendar for you. Not building in a vacuum
